descriptions.w3d_d31e_load_sound_bank_801dbeb4: Loads a MusyX sound bank by base name: first walks the group definitions (56-byte records ending with a null first word): if a group with the record's id is not in the list at +36, calls the add slot and searches the same record again; once found, calls the attach slot and advances. If not already started, loads <name>.pool, .proj, .samp (from the audio heap) and .sdir through 0x801db7a8, returning 0 on the first failure; stops any running sound system, starts it with the four buffers, sets the master volume 127/0/255, frees the sample buffer and clears +196. Always returns 0. Names are inferred.
